sentences.c: 永和九年，岁在癸丑，暮春之初，会于会稽山阴之兰亭，修禊事也。
sentences.m: 永和九年，也就是癸丑年，暮春三月初，我们在会稽郡山阴县的兰亭聚会，举行修禊之事。
sentences.e: In the ninth year of Yonghe, the year of Guichou, in the first days of late spring, we gathered at the Orchid Pavilion in Shanyin, Kuaiji, for the purification rite.

sentences.m: 众多贤士都到了，年长的、年轻的全都聚在一起。
sentences.e: All the worthy men were present, and both elders and youths had assembled.

sentences.c: 此地有崇山峻岭，茂林修竹，又有清流激湍，映带左右，引以为流觞曲水，列坐其次。
sentences.m: 这里有高峻的山岭、茂密的树林和高长的竹子，还有清澈湍急的溪流，辉映环绕在左右；我们把溪水引来作为流觞的曲水，大家依次坐在水边。
sentences.e: This place has towering peaks and steep ridges, dense woods and tall bamboo, and clear rushing streams that shine and wind about us; we drew the water in to form a winding course for floating wine cups, and sat down along its banks in order.

sentences.c: 虽无丝竹管弦之盛，一觞一咏，亦足以畅叙幽情。
sentences.m: 虽然没有热闹的管弦音乐，但喝一杯酒、赋一首诗，也足以畅快地抒发深远的情怀。
sentences.e: Though we lacked the flourish of strings and pipes, a cup of wine and a poem were enough to voice our deepest feelings freely.

sentences.c: 是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅。
sentences.m: 这一天，天色晴朗，空气清新，柔和的春风温和舒畅。
sentences.e: That day the sky was bright, the air was clear, and a gentle breeze blew soft and mild.

sentences.c: 仰观宇宙之大，俯察品类之盛，所以游目骋怀，足以极视听之娱，信可乐也。
sentences.m: 抬头看天地的广阔，低头看万物的繁盛，借此纵目远眺、舒展胸怀，足以穷尽视听的乐趣，实在让人快乐。
sentences.e: Looking up at the vastness of the universe and down at the abundance of all things, letting our eyes roam and our hearts run free, we exhausted the delights of sight and sound — truly a joy.

sentences.m: 人与人相互交往，一俯一仰之间就已过完一生。
sentences.e: As people associate with one another, a whole lifetime passes in the blink of an eye.

sentences.c: 或取诸怀抱，悟言一室之内；或因寄所托，放浪形骸之外。
sentences.m: 有的人把自己的胸怀抱负说出来，在一间屋里与朋友倾谈；有的人把情怀寄托在所爱好的事物上，放纵身形、不受拘束。
sentences.e: Some unburden their hearts in talk with friends within a single room; others entrust themselves to what they love and let their bodies wander free of all restraint.

sentences.c: 虽趣舍万殊，静躁不同，当其欣于所遇，暂得于己，快然自足，不知老之将至；
sentences.m: 虽然取舍千差万别，性情安静或急躁也各不相同，但当他们对自己遇到的事物感到欣喜，暂时得到满足，就快乐自足，不知道衰老将要到来；
sentences.e: Though their choices differ vastly and their temperaments range from calm to restless, when they rejoice in what they encounter and are briefly satisfied, they are happy and self-sufficient, unaware that old age is drawing near;

sentences.c: 及其所之既倦，情随事迁，感慨系之矣。
sentences.m: 等到对所追求的东西厌倦了，感情随着事物变化，感慨也就随之而来了。
sentences.e: then, once weariness with what they pursue sets in and feeling shifts with circumstance, sighs of emotion follow.

sentences.c: 向之所欣，俯仰之间，已为陈迹，犹不能不以之兴怀，况修短随化，终期于尽！
sentences.m: 从前所欣喜的东西，转眼之间已成为旧迹，尚且不能不因此心生感触，何况寿命长短听凭造化，最终都要归于消亡！
sentences.e: What once delighted us becomes a thing of the past in an instant, and still we cannot help but be stirred by it — how much more so when length of life is left to fate and all must end in nothingness!

sentences.c: 古人云：「死生亦大矣。」岂不痛哉！
sentences.m: 古人说：「死生也是件大事啊。」怎能不让人痛心呢！
sentences.e: The ancients said, "Life and death are indeed a great matter." How could it not grieve us!

sentences.c: 每览昔人兴感之由，若合一契，未尝不临文嗟悼，不能喻之于怀。
sentences.m: 每当看到前人引发感慨的原因，竟像符契一样吻合，没有一次不对着文章叹息悲伤，心里却说不清是什么滋味。
sentences.e: Whenever I read why the people of old were moved, it fits together like the two halves of a tally; never once have I faced their words without sighing in sorrow, unable to explain the feeling to my own heart.

sentences.c: 固知一死生为虚诞，齐彭殇为妄作。
sentences.m: 本来就知道把死和生看作一样是虚妄的，把长寿和短命看作等同是荒诞的。
sentences.e: I well know that to treat life and death as the same is a hollow fiction, and to equate long life with early death a wild invention.

sentences.c: 后之视今，亦犹今之视昔。
sentences.m: 后人看现在，也就像现在的人看过去一样。
sentences.e: Those who come after will look on us as we look on those who came before.

sentences.c: 悲夫！故列叙时人，录其所述，虽世殊事异，所以兴怀，其致一也。
sentences.m: 可悲啊！所以我一一记下当时参与的人，抄录他们所作的诗；虽然时代不同、事情各异，但引发感慨的原因是一样的。
sentences.e: How sad! So I have listed those present and recorded what they wrote; though ages differ and circumstances change, the cause of such emotion is one and the same.

sentences.c: 后之览者，亦将有感于斯文。
sentences.m: 后世的读者，也将对这篇文章有所感慨吧。
sentences.e: And those who read this in times to come will surely be moved by it as well.
